title: Einstiegsmöglichkeit in den Vertrieb (SDR) - ohne Vorerfahrung möglich
description:
ÜBER JUPUS

JUPUS baut die erste KI, die 80% der Arbeit in Anwaltskanzleien selbstständig erledigt. In drei Jahren ist JUPUS mit 80+ Mitarbeitenden in Köln und Berlin sowie einem international verteilten Tech- und Product-Team zu einem der schnellstwachsenden Legal Tech Unternehmen in Europa geworden. Über 2.000 Anwälte vertrauen JUPUS täglich ihre Mandate an und wir sind erst am Anfang, um juristische Arbeit für die nächsten 200 Jahre neu zu definieren.

 

WARUM JETZT?

Die Rechtsbranche steht an einem Wendepunkt:

- Kanzleien finden immer schwerer qualifizierte Mitarbeitende

- Die Arbeitslast steigt kontinuierlich

- Durch KI entstehen neue Möglichkeiten, effizienter zu arbeiten
Genau hier setzt JUPUS an - und wächst aktuell besonders stark.

 

DEINE EINSTIEGSMÖGLICHKEIT

Du interessierst dich für AI, Tech und moderne Geschäftsmodelle und willst in den Vertrieb einsteigen? Bei uns bekommst du einen strukturierten Einstieg. Du lernst die Grundlagen des Vertriebs in einem wachsenden Unternehmen kennen und kannst nach deinem Studium auch in Vollzeit bei uns durchstarten.

 

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Du arbeitest mit vorhandenen Leads-Listen (kalte und warme Leads) und kontaktierst potenzielle Kund:innen per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn

- Du führst erste Gespräche und qualifizierst Leads

- Du findest heraus, wo Kanzleien Herausforderungen haben und wie JUPUS helfen kann

- Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Sales-Kolleg:innen und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Übergang

- Du bringst eigene Ideen in das Sales Playbook ein und testest neue Ansätze

ANFORDERUNGSPROFIL

- Interesse an AI, Tech und modernen Geschäftsmodellen

- Kommunikativ, neugierig und lernbereit

- Lust, Vertrieb wirklich von Grund auf zu verstehen

- Keine Vorerfahrung im Vertrieb nötig - Motivation und Offenheit zählen

- Teamplayer mit dem Wunsch, gemeinsam zu wachsen

- Deutsch auf Muttersprachler-Niveau, Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus

- (Bald) abgeschlossenes Studium

 

WAS WIR BIETEN

- unser Kölner Büro am Friesenplatz (hybrid - davon 3 vor Ort)

- Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft, Team-Events, MacBook usw. - alles dabei 😃

- Intensive Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Vertriebs-Kolleg:innen

- Viel Verantwortung und echtes Mitgestalten schon am Anfang

- Die Chance, modernes SaaS- und AI-Outbound Growth wirklich von der Pike auf zu lernen

- Ein vielfältiges, motiviertes Team, das gemeinsam die Branche verändert

 

WORAUF ES UNS ANKOMMT

Wir suchen keine klassischen „Ego-Sales-Typen“, sondern Menschen, die gemeinsam im Team wachsen wollen und Drive haben. Neue Perspektiven und frische Ideen sind ausdrücklich willkommen!

 

INTERESSE GEWECKT?

Bewirb dich unkompliziert - ein Lebenslauf und ein paar ehrliche Zeilen genügen. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

title: Payroll Tax Analyst
description:
About Melita

Melita is an HR, Benefits, and Payroll outsourcing company, serving and building lasting relationships with small and mid-sized employers in the U.S. and abroad. We were founded over 30 years ago on a simple principle: to help our clients succeed by innovating, serving, and supporting their Human Resources, Employee Benefits, and Payroll needs. As a results-driven organization, we hold ourselves accountable for our promises and we celebrate the successes of our clients. We live by a set of shared values that drive everything we do, and we are known for our high-integrity approach to building relationships with our clients and partners.

Position Summary

The Payroll Tax Analyst is Melita's subject-matter expert on payroll tax across a growing, multi-client payroll operation. You own the accuracy and compliance of federal, state, and local payroll withholding and unemployment taxes for our clients, from registering new tax accounts, to auditing and reconciling tax records with the various payroll vendors (ADP, Paylocity and Rippling), to resolving agency notices and filing amendments.

This is an important role for a detail-driven professional who loves payroll, enjoys working with numbers, and takes pride in getting every filing exactly right. If you are a strong performer who wants real ownership of the payroll tax function, this position and Melita may be a great fit for you.

Core Responsibilities

Payroll Tax Subject-Matter Expertise

• Serve as Melita's subject-matter expert on payroll tax calculation rules, tax reporting, and tax form filing for federal, state, and local withholding and unemployment taxes.

• Research federal, state, and local payroll tax laws, rates, and requirements, and translate them into correct, compliant processing for our clients.

• Partner with the Payroll Services Manager on tax-related matters and advise the team on complex, multi-state situations.
Tax Account Setup and Agency Management

• Register new federal, state, and local payroll tax accounts for clients as needed, and keep account details current.

• Resolve agency tax notices promptly and completely, serving as the point of contact with taxing agencies and payroll vendor.
Compliance, Audits, and Amendments

• Use the various payroll technologies to audit, reconcile, and maintain payroll tax records against established standards, including quarter-end and year-end reconciliation.

• Our clients’ payroll vendors do the heavy lifting for payroll tax filing and payments. As needed, you’ll work with federal, state, and local tax agencies to process amended returns and submit payments.
Client and Team Partnership

• Build strong, trusting relationships with clients and colleagues, grounded in accuracy, responsiveness, and a shared drive for excellent results.

• Communicate clearly and keep clean, well-documented records of every registration, filing, and adjustment.
Cross-Training and Payroll Support

• Cross-train on payroll processing and support the broader Payroll Services team as needed.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• 3 to 5 years of payroll and payroll tax experience, including multi-state payroll and tax processing on a payrollservices platform.

• Experience researching federal, state, and local payroll tax laws, processes, and policies to verify compliance.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and customer-service skills, with a high attention to detail.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, and Outlook.

• Excellent communication, organizational, and time-management skills.

• A commitment to quality work and a strong desire to excel in all your endeavors.
Preferred Qualifications

• A degree in accounting or a related field.

• A current FPC or CPP certification.

• Ability to coordinate with payroll resources across global markets.

• Knowledge of payroll tax processing through ADP Workforce Now, Paylocity and/or Rippling

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Privacy Manager who is best in class, with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle is building a formal, company-wide privacy program on the NIST Privacy Framework, and we are hiring the person who will build it and run it. This is a ground-floor build with the hard parts already cleared: executive sponsorship is in place, the implementation roadmap is defined, and the core program materials are drafted. Your job is to turn that foundation into an operating program, and then to own the program as it matures.

As our Privacy Manager, you will drive the implementation end to end: the enterprise data map, the privacy risk assessments, the privacy review process, the de-identification standard, and the governance rhythm that keeps it all running. This role sits at the intersection of privacy and product. The goal is not to slow the business down; it is to give every data initiative a fast, well-documented path to yes, including the data-driven products and analytics that are central to Sezzle’s strategy. You will ensure our data practices protect our users across the US and Canada while enabling our product and engineering teams to build at speed.

What You’ll Do:

• Build the program: Drive Sezzle’s implementation of the NIST Privacy Framework from roadmap to operating program, including Current and Target Profiles, gap analysis, a prioritized and costed action plan, and ongoing monitoring, aligned with US state and federal requirements (CCPA/CPRA and other state comprehensive privacy laws, GLBA, TCPA) and Canadian privacy laws (PIPEDA and Quebec’s Law 25).

• Run privacy review: Own privacy risk assessments and Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) for new products, features, and third-party vendors, and operate an intake and disposition process that gives every proposal a fast, documented answer: approved, approved with controls, or needs redesign.

• Own the data map and consumer rights: Build and maintain the enterprise data inventory and data map in partnership with Engineering, tracking the lifecycle of consumer information, and manage the automation and fulfillment of consumer access, deletion, and opt-out requests.

• Operationalize privacy-enhancing techniques: Administer Sezzle’s de-identification and aggregation standard and its approval workflow so that data-driven products and analytics ship with the right controls designed in from the start.

• Embed privacy-by-design: Partner directly with Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams during early-stage development so that privacy requirements are designed in, not bolted on.

• Govern, measure, and report: Run the cadence of Sezzle’s cross-functional privacy working group, maintain the program’s decision log and obligations register, track program metrics, and support executive and board-level reporting. Collaborate closely with the Information Security team to manage, investigate, and mitigate privacy

title: Technical Support Engineer (SIP / VoIP / FoIP)
description:
T38Fax is seeking a talented Technical Support Engineer with experience troubleshooting SIP / VoIP / FoIP issues in a customer-facing role. We're excited to be scaling our customer support team to keep up with the rapid growth of our popular T.38 Fax Over IP (FoIP) service. In this junior-level role we don't require you to know much about T.38 FoIP or even fax at the outset -- just bring your networking and/or SIP protocol knowledge, and we'll teach you fax and FoIP.
First, a Word About Fax
Fans of John Oliver’s “How Is This Still A Thing” segments might be amused to learn that fax remains deeply entrenched in the way many companies transact their daily business. Indeed, it seems fax is still very much a thing! In its annual report on the fax industry, Business Research Insights reports that the global fax market size was 2.36 billion in 2023 and is projected to reach 4.25 billion by 2032 at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of almost 7%. It’s especially surprising, then, that most modern VoIP/SIP and cloud-based phone companies neither support fax over SIP nor understand how they might do so (until we show them how easy it is). Our fax-approved SIP trunks are ready to go today and fill a vital need in a growing and underserved industry that shows no signs of slowing down for many years to come.
About You
As a Technical Support Engineer you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving customer issues related to SIP trunking, T.38 fax transmissions, call quality, and network configurations. You will work closely with customers, internal teams, and vendors to ensure seamless communication experiences. You are a proud, card-carrying tech-geek with a superhero’s penchant for helping others. You breathe all things engineering, innovation, and data. Logic is your friend, and you use it generously. Equipped with an entrepreneurial attitude, you are relentlessly energetic and excited by new challenges. If you aren’t multi-tasking, it means you are under-challenged. You don’t just capture packets, you use science (not superstition) to tame them.
Your Mission
This is absolutely not an IT help-desk role. We call our support team 'engineers' because of the highly technical nature of troubleshooting SIP and T.38 at industrial scale. You will:

• Provide Tier 1 / Tier 2 support for FoIP and SIP-related technical issues via email, phone and case management system (Zendesk).

• Diagnose and troubleshoot SIP signaling, call setup failures, one-way audio, jitter, latency, and packet loss.

• Analyze SIP traces, PCAP captures, and logs using tools like Wireshark and tcpdump.

• Support T.38 Fax Over IP (FoIP) implementations, troubleshooting failed fax transmissions and improving reliability.

• Work with PBX systems (Asterisk, FreePBX, 3CX, etc.), VoIP gateways, and SBCs.

• Assist customers with network configurations, NAT traversal and firewall rules.

• Escalate complex issues to engineering teams and collaborate with vendors as needed.

• Take ownership of reported customer issues and see problems through to resolution, ensuring proper recording and closure of all issues.

• Write documentation, knowledge base articles and FAQs, and document troubleshooting steps, best practices and solutions in the company's knowledge base for use by both internal staff and customers.

• Test interoperability of new VoIP/FoIP equipment and create user guides for various IP-PBX and SIP-compatible devices for use with our SIP Trunking service.

Qualifications
Expert-level support is a core component of our brand and is deeply ingrained in our culture. We look for a mix of the technical expertise, troubleshooting skills, and industry knowledge that will be needed to solve complex problems, including:

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field, or combination of education and experience may be considered.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Create and maintain detailed, day-to-day production schedules that translate the production plan into executable work on the manufacturing floor.

Analyze schedule performance and identify emerging risks to delivery timelines, escalating issues before they impact critical milestones.

Generate and monitor key execution metrics, including schedule adherence, work order completion, lead times and work-in-progress.

Contribute to the development of scalable scheduling processes and tools as Proxima transitions from prototype manufacturing to industrial deployment.

title: AI Engineer
description:
ABOUT US:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.
Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build and run the agents at the heart of Tebi OS. You’ll design, ship, evaluate and scale our Product Agents, along with the data pipelines, tools and infrastructure that make them reliable in production.

The ideal candidate started in data or ML engineering and has since moved into AI engineering, building LLM-powered agents for real users. You enjoy turning messy financial and operational data into context an agent can reason over and act on with confidence and you are passionate about solving product challenges through AI.

You’ll work closely with product and engineering to put intelligence into the hands of hospitality teams. That could be an agent that answers questions about a restaurant’s finances in real time, one that automates repetitive back-office tasks, or internal tools that help us move faster.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Design, build and operate production agents: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory, multi-step reasoning, and integration with Tebi’s backend services

- Build the data foundations agents rely on, including real-time and batch pipelines over financial and operational data, retrieval layers, and well-modeled datasets agents can query safely and accurately

- Turn APIs and internal services into well-defined agent tools, and own the contracts between agents and the rest of the platform

- Set up evaluation for agent behavior: offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, regression testing on prompt and model changes, and feedback loops that improve agents over time

- Own observability for agents in production by tracing sessions, tool calls and model calls, and tracking latency, cost, error rates and quality

- Work with product teams to find where agents can meaningfully improve the customer experience or internal workflows, and say clearly where they can’t

- Make sure agents handle data securely and responsibly, with sensible guardrails, access controls, and protection against prompt injection and data leakage

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

- 7+ years in software engineering, with a solid base in data or ML engineering

- Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agents to production, not just prototypes. You’ve dealt with flaky tool calls, runaway loops, hallucinated arguments and token budgets, and you have opinions on how to handle them.

- Strong data modeling and data warehousing fundamentals, plus experience with ingestion, transformation and data quality

- Strong SQL, and experience with pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and analytical or cloud data platforms (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake)

- Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems, and an understanding of the full lifecycle from experiment to deployment to ongoing improvement

- Backend engineering skills: you’re comfortable building the API endpoint that exposes an agent’s output to the frontend, or the service an agent calls as a tool

- Clear communication, including the ability to explain trade-offs in latency, cost, accuracy and complexity to product partners

- A product mindset. You care about how your work lands with users, and you’re keen to meet customers face to face to understand their needs.

This probably isn't the role for you if you have been working with AI agents to improve your day to day working flows but you haven’t built an Agent in the production.

title: Nurse Practitioner / Physician Assistant / Certified Nurse Midwife
description:
About Babyscripts

Babyscripts is a leading innovator in digital maternal health, transforming pregnancy and postpartum care through remote patient monitoring (RPM) and digital engagement. Our solutions enable OB providers and health systems to monitor patients in real time, improving access, early intervention, and overall outcomes in maternal-fetal health.
About the Role
We are seeking a Qualified Healthcare Provider (QHCP) - Nurse Practitioner, Physician Assistant, or Certified Nurse Midwife - to join our remote clinical operations team on a fractional or part-time basis.
This role requires active licensure in the state of Texas, as the provider will support patients and clinical partners located in Texas.
In this role, you will leverage your clinical expertise to review vitals data, assess patient communications, and document clinical summaries that support key customer and quality requirements. The QHCP will also participate in targeted patient outreach for elevated readings, symptoms, or follow-up coordination as part of our virtual maternal health model.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced clinician seeking flexible, remote work while contributing meaningfully to a growing digital health company advancing maternal outcomes nationwide.
Time Commitment: Approximately 10-20 hours per week, with flexibility based on business needs and case volume.
Key Responsibilities

• Monitor patient data trends (e.g., blood pressure, weight, symptoms) and identify high-risk cases requiring intervention.

• Perform clinical assessments via phone, telehealth, or messaging to provide education, intervention, and care plan adjustments.

• Provide direct patient education on managing hypertension, gestational diabetes, preeclampsia risks, postpartum recovery, and other maternal health concerns.

• Escalate high-risk cases to the appropriate provider per established protocols.

• Support care coordination by assisting patients with referrals, scheduling follow-ups, and connecting them to additional resources.

• Ensure compliance with RPM protocols by coaching patients on adherence and addressing barriers to engagement.

• Document all clinical interactions in Babyscripts ' care management platform, ensuring accuracy and compliance with healthcare regulations.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

• Clinical Data Review: Analyze patient vitals data (e.g., blood pressure, glucose, weight, symptoms) and message histories to identify trends, risk factors, and potential clinical concerns.

• Clinical Documentation: Create and validate summary notes or Evidence of Care (EoC) reports supporting provider review and quality reporting requirements.

• Patient Outreach: Conduct focused patient outreach via phone or secure messaging to verify readings, reinforce care plans, or assess for warning signs when needed.

• Quality Assurance: Ensure data completeness, appropriate clinical coding alignment, and compliance with Babyscripts protocols and payer requirements.

• Provider Coordination: Escalate abnormal findings or nonresponsive patients per established triage and escalation pathways.

• Continuous Improvement: Provide clinical feedback to support optimization of Babyscripts ’ workflows, triggers, and RPM care logic.

Qualifications

• Active, unrestricted NP, PA, or CNM license in the state of Texas (required).

• Minimum of 3-5 years of clinical experience in OB/GYN, women’s health, maternal-fetal medicine, or related fields.

• Prior experience with remote patient monitoring, telehealth, or population health preferred.

• Strong ability to synthesize data and communicate concise clinical insights.

• Comfort navigating EHRs, care management platforms, and digital tools.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

• Bilingual (Spanish) strongly preferred.

Compensation & Structure

• Type: Fractional / 1099 or W2 part-time (based on preference and local regulations).

• Compensation: Competitive hourly or per-review

title: Membership Data SME
description:
At Connect Centric , we are more than just consultants-we are partners committed to our clients' success. We take a hands-on approach, working closely with our clients to transform strategies into measurable, real-world outcomes. As a strategy execution team, we take full ownership of every initiative from start to finish, ensuring that our clients see tangible results, not just ideas.
Position Description
Connect Centric is seeking a Membership Data SME to lead a strategic data initiative for a national trade association. Over the next six months, you'll partner with the client's marketing and operations leadership to build foundational member data systems, establish sources of truth across disparate platforms, and create a roadmap for long-term data governance.

You'll work across multiple enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, AMS, and supporting applications) to audit current state, identify inconsistencies, and define clear data requirements. Your expertise will directly shape how the organization understands and manages its member relationships. This is hands-on, practical work-not a theoretical exercise. You'll lead the effort and actively partner with internal teams to turn strategy into actionable deliverables.
What You Will Do
Data Strategy and Requirements Definition

• Lead the design and development of a comprehensive data dictionary covering five core domains: Person/Contact, Organization/Account, Membership & Affiliation, Relationship & Engagement, and Reference & Master Data.

• Define clear, business-focused data requirements that translate member journey insights and strategic goals into technical specifications for implementation teams.

• Establish sources of truth and business rules for key data elements, ensuring consistency across multiple systems.

• Document member journeys, lifecycle stages (join, renew, lapse), member types, and organization-to-contact relationships and affiliations.

System Analysis and Data Integration

• Assess current state across the client's technology ecosystem: ERP platform, two CRM instances, association management system (AMS), and supporting applications.

• Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improved data quality and integration.

• Lead record matching, data cleanup, and reconciliation efforts across multiple systems.

• Recommend practical approaches to unify member data without imposing heavyweight or unrealistic frameworks.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Facilitation

• Facilitate agreement across marketing, operations, IT, and other stakeholders on data definitions, ownership, and accountability.

• Drive decision-making and closure on critical data governance questions.

• Translate complex data concepts into member and business terms for non-technical leaders.

• Assess existing work, clarify ambiguity, and establish practical priorities aligned with organizational readiness.

Knowledge Transfer and Capability Building

• Establish practical data ownership and stewardship structures that the client team can sustain independently.

• Transfer expertise to internal team members so they can own, evolve, and manage data governance after the engagement concludes.

• Document processes, decisions, and lessons learned to support long-term success.

• Mentor internal staff on data best practices specific to association and membership contexts.

Required Qualifications

• Significant membership data experience at trade or professional associations-in-house or as a consultant primarily serving associations.

• Deep working knowledge of member journeys, membership lifecycles (join, renew, lapse), member types, and organization-to-contact relationships and affiliations.

• Hands-on AMS platform experience (iMIS, Personify, NetForum, Fonteva, or similar), including data cleanup, integration, and migration work.

About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud - managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

While there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is even more opportunity ahead of us. As we are continuing to grow, we’re seeking a Sr. Software Engineer - B2 Object Storage to join our team!

You will help build new features, improve the scalability of our systems, and build internal observability tooling.

Responsibilities:

• Design, implement, and maintain B2 and S3-compatible APIs to ensure correctness, performance, and backward compatibility for a large base of external customers and integrations.

• Lead technical design discussions and produce clear design documents

• Instrument services, develop metrics, define meaningful SLIs/SLOs, and drive reliability improvements.

• Actively participate in on-call rotation to help determine incident root causes and identify follow-up remediation items

• 7+ years of server-side Java programming experience with a strong background in algorithms and data structures

• Experience writing software for large scale distributed systems, including design, implementation, testing, and rollout

• Communicates proactively in a remote environment by keeping the team informed, surfacing blockers early, and moving work forward

• Professional experience incorporating AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Gemini, Cursor, Claude Code)

Bonus points for:

• Cassandra and Vitess experience

• Agile and scrum experience

At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you're reading. Learning, developing, and growing are key parts of our culture, so even if you don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. That’s why diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. We believe that our dedication to cultivating a diverse workspace not only allows us to better serve our customers in over 175 countries but further reinforces our commitment to doing the right thing. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Outside Sales Representative
description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform-where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.
 
Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

Role Summary:
 
Here's the honest pitch: field sales is a brand-new motion at Filevine, and we're looking for the person who builds it. Not runs a proven playbook - writes it. You'll be the first Filevine salesperson to plant a flag in your territory, and everything you learn on the ground becomes the blueprint for the reps who come after you. If "figure it out and build it from scratch" makes you lean in rather than flinch, keep reading.

This is a true outside sales role. You'll be in the field at least four days a week - walking into law firms, meeting paralegals and attorneys face-to-face, working bar association events, and becoming the most familiar name in your territory for deposition services.

This isn't an email job. It's not a Zoom job. You win by showing up - consistently, professionally, and with something useful to say every time. You'll also need range: the ability to build rapport in the reception area and get your foot in the door with a paralegal, and the sophistication to sit across from a managing partner and hold your own on price, value, and strategy. This is a premium-priced product in a market full of commodity providers - so you have to be able to sell the difference, not just the service. If you love the rhythm of door-to-door selling, can navigate a downtown legal corridor, and have the discipline to run a territory like your own small business, you'll thrive here. There is no ceiling on your earnings

title: Relationship Manager
description:
Company Overview:
GovSpend provides data and analytics to organizations buying and selling in the public sector. With transparency and accountability at the center of what we do, we strive to place critical market intelligence into the hands of our customers so they can win more government business.
Our Mission:
At GovSpend , our vision is to be the indispensable system of action that powers how organizations discover, pursue, and win opportunities in the public sector marketplace.
Through our cutting-edge technology and platform, we harvest the data and produce the insights that enable our clients to make data-driven decisions and thrive in the dynamic landscape of government procurement. Together, we shape a more efficient, informed, and impactful public sector ecosystem.
Position Summary:
The Relationship Manager serves as the primary point of contact and sales enabler, driving revenue for a book of GovSpend ’s largest customers.
What you’ll do:

• Responsible for account planning to ensure proactive customer outreach and training with the goal of increasing users and usage.

• Act as the customer point of contact, ensuring clear and consistent communication across inbound service activities, upsells into the account and outbound customer outreach.

• Serve as the main negotiator for commercial terms with customers on contract issues, renewal pricing and past due payments in addition to being proactive with renewals.

• Manage and coordinate the processing, communication, and implementation of all customer changes, including performing modifications on searches per customer requests.

• Maintain awareness of all service matters including, troubleshooting, screen sharing, support sessions, and any other solution needed.

• Coordinate service activities with GovSpend ’s internal teams to ensure all customer needs and expectations are met.

• Adhere to customer needs and expectations, by interfacing between sales and the customer to build a strategy for success during a customer’s subscription period.

• Ensure compliance levels are met in accordance with all maintenance contracted service level agreements.

• Maintain a high level of awareness of service issues affecting GovSpend ’s product environment including proactive problem avoidance, behavior, and maintenance practices.

• Identify, facilitate, and ensure effective communication of all technical queries and problem resolution from the customer.

• Escalate appropriate retention efforts to their manager.

• Participate in Root Cause Analysis including incident and problem management activities.

• Ensure that GovSpend ’s best practices and methodologies are adhered to on a consistent basis.

• Other job duties as assigned to meet the business needs.

Security Responsibilities:

• Follow GovSpend 's Information Security Policy and Acceptable Use Policy, and acknowledge the Acceptable Use Policy before receiving system access.

• Complete security awareness training at hire and on an ongoing basis.

• Use only the access needed for the job. Never share passwords or accounts, and use multi-factor authentication (MFA).

• Use only the company-issued laptop for GovSpend work, with encryption and automatic screen lock turned on.

• Do not send company data to personal email or store it in personal cloud storage.

• Connect to the company VPN before accessing GovSpend systems on public Wi-Fi.

• Report suspected security incidents, phishing, or a lost or stolen device right away to DevSecOps or the ISMS Lead. Lost or stolen devices are also reported to IT.

• Get ISMS Lead review before adopting a new tool or vendor that will access or store GovSpend data.

• Oversee the vendor day to day and raise security concerns to the ISMS Lead.
